name: Kamikaze Kenshi Rosetta 3 ~Shikabaneto no Maihime~
original_name: 神風剣士ロゼッタ3 ～屍都の舞姫～
source:
Main character is appointed as a kingdom swordsmanship mentor. Every day he has to deal with little selfish princess and a shrine maiden proud of her skills. But he meets another girl there that changes his ordinary life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被任命为王国剑术导师。每天，他都要应付任性的小公主，以及一名为自己的技艺感到骄傲的巫女。然而，他在那里遇见了另一名改变自己平凡生活的女孩。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
